GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_DETAIL: Equipped weapons and outfits give 100% of their stats. Stored weapons still give 30%, and stored outfits give 15%. Tap your level bar, then Stats, to see how your gear helps you.
GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_OPEN_DETAIL: Stats lists everything that makes your hero stronger.
GUIDE_GEAR_BONUS_STATS_DETAIL: This line shows the share stored gear gives. Close Stats to continue.
GUIDE_OFFLINE_REWARDS_DETAIL: You earn Coins and Gems while offline. In Upgrades → Offline, you can also unlock Weapons, Outfits and Supplies from items you own, then improve their reward rates. Take a look; you don't need to buy anything now.
GUIDE_RESPAWN_SELECT_DETAIL: Open World and choose your newly unlocked camp. This is where you'll return after being defeated.
GUIDE_RESPAWN_SELECT_TAP_DETAIL: Select your newly unlocked camp. This is where you'll return after being defeated.
GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_DETAIL: You now have two unlocked camps in Winter I. Open World, choose a different camp and tap Travel. Traveling does not change your selected respawn camp.
GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_TAP_DETAIL: Travel to your other camp. Traveling does not change your selected respawn camp.
GUIDE_CAMP_TRAVEL_WAIT_DETAIL: You can't travel during combat. Step away from enemies, then travel to your other camp.
GUIDE_BOSS_FOUND_DETAIL: Finding a boss unlocks Prestige opportunities. First, let's make the World map more useful. Open World.
GUIDE_MAP_DETAILS_DETAIL: In Map upgrades, buy the first Map detail rank. It reveals enemy and boss markers for places you've discovered.
GUIDE_MAP_DETAILS_EARN_DETAIL: %s more Coins needed. Keep defeating enemies.
GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_DETAIL: Open World and look for the new enemy markers. Use them to find places to farm.
GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_TAP_DETAIL: Markers show enemies you've discovered. Use them to find places to farm.
GUIDE_ENEMY_PINS_EXPLORE_DETAIL: Markers appear only for enemies you've discovered. Walk into the fog to find more.
GUIDE_HUNT_FOLLOW_DETAIL: A mission to defeat 30 enemies is now available. Open Missions and tap Follow to pin its progress to your screen. Any enemy counts.
GUIDE_HUNT_FARM_DETAIL: Farm any enemies you can beat. Check their locations using the markers on your World map. Follow your mission's progress until it reaches 30/30.
GUIDE_HUNT_CLAIM_DETAIL: Your 30-enemy mission is complete! Open Missions and tap Claim.
GUIDE_BOSS_PRESTIGE_FOLLOW_DETAIL: Open Prestige and follow the Snowman opportunity. Defeat the Snowman once to complete it.
GUIDE_BOSS_WIN: Get stronger, then defeat the Snowman.
GUIDE_BOSS_WIN_DETAIL: The Snowman may be too strong now. Keep farming, merging equipment and buying upgrades until you can win. Your followed Prestige opportunity will update when you defeat it.
GUIDE_WORLD_OPEN_DETAIL: Winter II is unlocked. Open World to choose your next stage.
GUIDE_WINTER_TWO_TRAVEL_DETAIL: Select Winter II and travel to its arrival camp.
GUIDE_PRESTIGE_OPTIONAL_DETAIL: You've completed your first Prestige opportunity. You can Prestige now, or keep playing and complete more opportunities to redeem together in one reset. Open Prestige to see your choices; you don't have to reset.
GUIDE_PRESTIGE_OPTIONAL_PANEL_DETAIL: Your Snowman opportunity is ready. Prestige now, or close this panel and keep playing to collect more opportunities first.
MAP_MARKER_RANK1: You've found enemies here. Map detail rank 2 shows who they are.
STATS_STORED_EXPLAIN: Equipped weapons and outfits give 100%% of their stats. Gear you only store still helps: weapons give %s%% and outfits %s%%. The HP and Damage breakdowns below show what your stored gear adds.
OFFLINE_TAB_EXPLAIN: Coins and Gems build up while you're away. Unlock Weapons, Outfits and Supplies below to also receive copies of items you own, then raise their reward rates. Nothing here is required.
OFFLINE_ITEMS_HINT: While you're away you can also receive copies of weapons, outfits and supplies you own. Unlock them in Upgrades → Offline.
CONTENT_HUNTER_O1_FIRST_DESCRIPTION: Defeat the Snowman (Winter I boss) once
